warnings: Slab details 'ขยายพื้น' (S-12). PS1/PS2 on the plans share one precast-plank detail; the plank is recorded once as PS1 with both printed safe loads (300 / 400 Kg/m2) in the note — the sheet does not print a separate PS2 detail.

Lintel (ทับหลังทั่วไป 0.15x0.20, 2-ø9, 1ป-ø6@0.15), window-sill band (2-RB9, ป-RB6@0.15) and the corbel (หูช้างรับแผ่นพื้น, RB9@0.15 / RB6) details on the same sheet were not extracted in the first op04 run (scheduled shutdown); they were extracted in the 2026-10-22 resume run → หน้า28_view3_section_lintels_corbel.json.
